blocks.text: Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co. (Metrobank) has retained its position as the Philippines’ Strongest Bank for the sixth year in a row, with The Asian Banker (TAB) recognizing the Bank’s performance across key measures of financial strength, asset quality, liquidity, and risk management. “Our strength comes from the trust our customers place in us and the dedication of our Metrobankers, who remain committed to delivering financial solutions that help our clients succeed in different market conditions. This recognition reflects how we continue to grow stronger together with our clients, communities, and partners through every challenge and opportunity,” said Metrobank President Fabian […]...
